title: These are just ok.
text: These are just ok.. 1st off, these literally smelled like vomit when I took them out of the wrapping. It was so strong, I had to remove them from my bedroom and I put in laundry room to wait for washing. I forgot about them for a few hours and when I walked into my laundry room again, a vomit-smell cloud smacked me in the face and I immediately put them in washer. Luckily, the smell washed out. But they came out horribly wrinkled. I included a pix so you can see how they looked just after I took them out of dryer. I don't use dryer sheets, but do use the wool dryer balls. Also, included 1 pic close up to see color against a true white.
